command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd inventory-worker >/dev/null; then useradd --system --home-dir /var/lib/inventory --shell /sbin/nologin inventory-worker; fi
install -d -o inventory-worker -g inventory-worker -m 0700 /var/lib/inventory
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec
cat > /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker <<'INVENTORY_WORKER_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
workdir=/var/lib/inventory
printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$workdir/worker.pid"
trap 'rm -f "$workdir/worker.pid" "$workdir/heartbeat.tmp"; exit 0' TERM INT HUP
while :; do
  printf 'timestamp=%s pid=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$$" > "$workdir/heartbeat.tmp"
  mv -f "$workdir/heartbeat.tmp" "$workdir/heartbeat"
  sleep 5 &
  wait $!
done
INVENTORY_WORKER_SCRIPT
chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
chown root:root /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'INVENTORY_WORKER_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
Restart=always
RestartSec=2s
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
PrivateDevices=yes
PrivateNetwork=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
RestrictNamespaces=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
RemoveIPC=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
INVENTORY_WORKER_UNIT
restorecon -F /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service /var/lib/inventory 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
